opening_message:
Ticket 1: Andrew Mann (employee ID E014) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E014.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Andrew Mann (E014) is a full-time Payroll Specialist requesting write access to Payroll. Full-time employees may have up to write, and Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role. Write is at or below the maximum, so I recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security record for Andrew Mann (E014): contractor with basic security training. Contractors max at read unless they have advanced training. Requested write is above the maximum, so I recommend granting read.
reason: Andrew Mann (E014) requests write access to Payroll. HR records show he is a full-time Payroll Specialist (the role that owns Payroll). For full-time employees, the maximum is write, and admin is permitted only if the role owns the system; requested write is at or below the maximum, so write is granted. Note: the Security note lists him as a contractor, which conflicts with HR's employment record; relying on HR as the source of employment type, write is appropriate.
